column4: Ella is running happily across a park lawn, arms swinging, hair flying.
Leo is swimming in a blue swimming pool wearing goggles, splashing, only head and arms above the water.
Mia is dancing joyfully, twirling with one arm up, her dress swirling.
Ella is singing into a toy microphone, mouth open, a few music notes floating in the air.
Ben sits cross-legged reading an open picture book, looking at the pages.
Ella sits at a small desk writing with a pencil on paper, concentrating.
Leo is sleeping in bed with eyes closed, cuddling his pillow, night time.
Ella is crying, big tears running down her cheeks, rubbing one eye.
Ben is laughing out loud, eyes squeezed shut, holding his tummy.
Ella is climbing up a children's climbing wall with colourful holds, reaching for the next hold.
Leo is riding a small red bicycle with a helmet on, pedalling along a path.
Mia is surfing on a small surfboard on a gentle wave at the beach, arms out for balance.
Ella is waving hello with one hand raised high, smiling.
Ben is clapping his hands, smiling, little motion lines around his hands.
Leo is skiing down a snowy slope in a warm jacket, hat and goggles, holding ski poles.
Ella is yawning with a wide-open mouth, one hand covering it, sleepy eyes.
Dad is cooking: frying an egg in a pan on the stove, wearing an apron.
Ella is eating a bowl of noodles with chopsticks at the table, cheeks full.
Leo is drinking a glass of water, glass tipped up to his mouth.
Mia is washing dishes at the kitchen sink, with soap bubbles and a sponge, standing on a little stool.
Ben is cleaning the floor with a broom, sweeping dust into a dustpan.
Ella is painting a picture of a flower on an easel with a paintbrush, a palette in her other hand.
Leo is fishing with a fishing rod at the edge of a pond, a little fish on the line.
Mia is ice skating on an ice rink in a warm sweater and ice skates, gliding with arms out.
Ella is hugging Mom tightly, both smiling, eyes closed.
Ben is thinking hard, finger on his chin, looking up, a small thought cloud with a question mark shape (no letters) above his head.
Leo is sneezing into his elbow, eyes squeezed shut, tiny droplets in the air.
Mia is juggling three colourful balls in the air.
Ben is lifting a heavy box full of toys with both arms, straining a little.
Ella is bowling: she has just rolled a ball down a bowling lane toward white pins.
Ella is waking up in bed in the morning, sitting up and stretching, sun at the window.
Leo is brushing his teeth with a toothbrush, white foam at his mouth, in front of a bathroom mirror.
Ella is washing her hands with soap under a running tap, lots of bubbles.
Ella is getting dressed: pulling a sweater over her head, one arm in, in her bedroom.
Leo is eating breakfast: a bowl of cereal with milk and a spoon, toast on a plate, morning kitchen.
Ella is going to school: walking toward a school gate with her backpack, waving.
Leo is taking a bath in a bathtub full of bubbles, with a yellow rubber duck.
Ella is going to bed: climbing into bed in pink pyjamas with her teddy bear, night lamp on.
Leo is drinking a big glass of milk, a little milk moustache.
Ella is cleaning up: putting her toys back into a toy box.
Mom is reading a picture-book story to Ella on the sofa; Ella leans on her, looking at the book.
Leo is playing ball: kicking a football on the grass in a park.
Ella at her own birthday party with a cake with candles, balloons and friends' hands clapping around, Ella beaming with joy.
Leo playing with a fluffy puppy on the grass, the puppy jumping up to lick his face, Leo delighted.
Ella at an amusement park with a Ferris wheel and carousel behind her, holding candy floss, very happy.
Leo looking down at his ice-cream cone that has just fallen and splatted on the ground, holding the empty cone, sad.
Outdoors: Ella reaching up as her red balloon floats away into the sky, its string out of reach, sad.
Ella holding her teddy bear whose arm has come off (some stuffing showing), sad tears in her eyes.
In a dim hallway someone in a white bed-sheet ghost costume jumps out saying boo (no letters); Leo jumps back, scared.
At night, a bright lightning flash and storm outside the window; Ella hugs her pillow, scared.
A big dog barks loudly at Leo on the street; Leo steps back, scared.
Ben has just knocked over Ella's tall block tower, blocks tumbling; Ella stands with fists clenched, angry.
Ben grabs a cookie from Leo's plate and runs off with it; Leo frowns, angry, pointing at him.
Very late at night, a clock on the wall, dark window with moon; Ella in pyjamas rubbing her eyes and yawning, sleepy.
Evening sunset at the park after a long day of playing; Leo sits on a bench, tired, eyes half closed, muddy knees, ball beside him.
A green frog jumps out of a cardboard box right in front of Ella; Ella leans back, eyes and mouth wide, surprised.
A magician's top hat on a table with a white bunny popping out of it; Leo stares with wide eyes and open mouth, surprised.
